chapter: Harry James, Bellson and the return to Duke
title: No contracts in Duke's band
summary: Nobody had a written contract with Duke; Tizol insisted on a weekly wage, work or not, with extractions extra.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: You never had a contract with Duke?
Just a Yes. But a verbal contract, you know, a gentleman's agreement.
Did anybody in the band ever have a contract? I don't remember anybody having one.
I don't think he gave contracts.
Except It was later, when he decided to become a manager and he started managing singers and he'd sign a start signing contracts with them, but I don't think anybody in the band ever had one.

It's only so many ways that he'd pay you off. About to split the one nighters with theatre, with recording and this and the other. That's when I told him, "No, you give me so much a week -- you give me so much every week, work or don't work." But extractions come cost extra.
